observations.observation: Session manager owns lifecycle and resets retry after configuration changes.
observations.decision: Use a clean-room lease/teardown receipt and configuration-bound retry reset.

observations.observation: Adaptive compression exposes ratio, rationale, classification and token savings.
observations.decision: Record bounded compaction receipts and fail-safe passthrough without claiming model parity.

observations.observation: Flat path index is projected into a hierarchical file tree.
observations.strength: Stable identity independent of visible tree depth.
observations.decision: Keep path identity separate from IDE tree rendering and pointer grants.

observations.observation: Skill cards use immutable identity and progressive metadata/instructions/resources.
observations.strength: Reduces context pressure and supports activation approval.
observations.weakness: Documentation does not prove native MCP transport.
observations.decision: Use origin/path/revision/digest manifests and explicit activation consent.

observations.observation: Hybrid lexical/vector arms expose candidate/error stats and threshold decisions.
observations.decision: Bind arm stats, ranker/version, top-k and threshold to RAG receipts.

observations.observation: Typed model/context/compaction controls group provider choices and validation.
observations.weakness: Local UI state is not native catalog lineage.
observations.decision: Expose requested/applied/unsupported state and preserve active route identity during refresh.
